name: sv_discovery
title: SV Discovery Against Reference Genome
summary: Align user-submitted long reads to a chosen reference genome build and call structural variants with Sniffles2

inputSpec.name: reads
inputSpec.label: Input reads (FASTQ)
inputSpec.help: Long-read sequencing data (PacBio HiFi/CLR or ONT) in FASTQ format.

inputSpec.name: reference_build
inputSpec.label: Reference genome build
inputSpec.help: Which human reference genome build to align against.

inputSpec.name: preset
inputSpec.label: Alignment preset
inputSpec.help: Sequencing technology preset passed to the aligner.

inputSpec.name: min_sv_len
inputSpec.label: Minimum SV length
inputSpec.help: Minimum structural variant length reported by Sniffles2.

inputSpec.name: downsample
inputSpec.label: Downsample reads to target coverage
inputSpec.help: Randomly subsample reads to a target coverage before alignment, for fair comparisons across runs/references.

inputSpec.name: target_coverage
inputSpec.label: Target coverage (x)
inputSpec.help: Desired coverage depth after downsampling, e.g. 15 for 15x.

inputSpec.name: genome_size
inputSpec.label: Genome size (for coverage calculation)
inputSpec.help: Approximate genome size used to compute the downsampling fraction, e.g. 3.1g for the full human genome.
